name: Kelley Bean Co Inc
old_description: From our humble beginnings in 1927, we have traveled along a sustainable path of growth to become one of the largest originators and marketers of dry edible beans in the world. We are an employee and family owned company that is headquartered in Scottsbluff, Nebraska.
about:
Kelley Bean Co. traces its roots to 1927 when the Chester B. Brown Company was founded in Morrill, Nebraska, with Robert L. Kelley Sr. as plant manager. In 1969, Robert L. Kelley Sr. and his son Gary L. Kelley established Kelley Bean Co. in Henry, Nebraska. The business, now headquartered in Scottsbluff, Nebraska, remains employee- and family-owned, with a fourth generation led by Kevin Kelley.

The company originates, processes, and markets dry edible beans — including Pinto, Great Northern, and numerous other varieties — sourced from a network of grower partnerships across the High Plains. Processing facilities run a "triple clean" line: screen sizing, gravity separation (including de-stoners), and optical electric-eye sorting, supplemented by rare-earth magnets, metal detection, and pre-wash equipment. Kelley Bean operates multiple GFSI-certified plants and maintains its own P.A.S.S. (Process Assuring Safety and Specification) food-safety system. Through a series of acquisitions — including ConAgra's dry-bean operations in 2006 and recent purchases in North Dakota and Minnesota — the company has become one of the largest U.S. originators and processors of dry beans.

Customers span food manufacturers, food-service distributors, retail packers, and international buyers. The company works directly with growers (farmers) to secure supply, and its products serve the canning, packaging, and pre-wash segments for retail and restaurant use.

Kelley Bean emphasizes absolute integrity, hard work, and community involvement as core values. Its differentiators include the internally developed P.A.S.S. system, full supply-chain control, risk-management programs, and a "grown in the USA" commitment.
